official_sources: Compulsory purchase and compensation guide 1 procedure

official_measurement_examples.name: Current CPO guidance update
official_measurement_examples.fact: MHCLG compulsory purchase process guidance was updated 17 June 2026.

official_measurement_examples.name: CPO objection minimum window
official_measurement_examples.fact: Current guidance states the objection period in the notice must be at least 21 days.

official_measurement_examples.name: CPO inquiry timing guidance
official_measurement_examples.fact: Guidance says an inquiry will typically be held around six months after submission once needed, subject to case circumstances.

official_measurement_examples.name: CAAD legislative update
official_measurement_examples.fact: CPO guidance reflects Certificate of Appropriate Alternative Development changes effective 31 January 2025.

official_measurement_examples.name: Interest rates update mechanism
official_measurement_examples.fact: The prescribed Acquisition of Land Compensation Rate is published by the Debt Management Office and updated quarterly.

official_measurement_examples.name: Crichel Down lease threshold
official_measurement_examples.fact: The Crichel Down Rules apply to freehold disposals and creation/disposal of leases of more than 7 years where the rules otherwise apply.

official_measurement_examples.name: Upper Tribunal procedure update
official_measurement_examples.fact: T616 land compensation procedure guidance was updated 13 July 2026.

official_measurement_examples.name: Purchase notice scope
official_measurement_examples.fact: Purchase notices can apply in specified cases where adverse planning decisions leave land incapable of reasonably beneficial use.

core_rules: CPO made is not CPO confirmed
CPO confirmation is not possession of land
CPO confirmation is not completion of acquisition
acquiring-authority resolution is not a confirmed order
negotiation by agreement is not compulsory acquisition
CPO map is not a Land Registry title plan
plot reference is not proof of ownership
statement of reasons is not confirmation decision
publication of notice is not order approval
objection submitted is not objection upheld
absence of objections is not automatic confirmation
remaining objector status is procedural not merits success
public inquiry is not a planning permission decision
written representations are not confirmation
confirming authority can confirm modify or reject
typical inquiry timing is not a statutory guarantee
minimum 21-day objection period is not project delay forecast
CPO confirmation notice is not possession notice
notice to treat is distinct from general vesting declaration
general vesting declaration is not compensation payment
entry onto land and legal vesting must remain distinct
compensation entitlement is fact-specific
advance payment claim is not final compensation agreement
advance payment availability is not proof amount due
prescribed interest rate is not a parcel compensation value
quarterly interest table must be date-scoped
blight notice is not automatically accepted
blight notice eligibility is limited by statutory circumstances
accepted blight notice is not planning permission
purchase notice is distinct from blight notice
purchase notice service is not authority acceptance
reasonable beneficial use test is not a parcel score
Crichel Down Rules do not apply to every public-land disposal
Crichel Down first opportunity is not guaranteed repurchase outcome
more-than-7-year lease threshold is rule scope not entitlement proof
material change in land character can affect Crichel Down application
CAAD is not planning permission
CAAD indicates assumed alternative development for compensation purposes
CAAD application is not certificate issue
hope value rules must use current legislation
Land Compensation Manual caveats must be preserved
outdated manual text must not override current legislation
Upper Tribunal reference is not compensation award
tribunal procedure is not parcel value evidence
compensation dispute route is not order invalidation
NO_DATA must not become no acquisition risk
no parcel acquisition compensation or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
research confidence is not parcel compensation accuracy
